id: title:arthurdedeus:allow the js url origin in the dev policy

review.posthog_relevance: Adds CSP middleware support for remote Vite hosts in debug/test mode, allowing the script-src directive to include the remote host alongside localhost.
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a computed bundle_origin and updates resource_url construction to include the remote Vite host in the CSP script-src directive, while P1.F2.H1 adds a regression test. P1.F1.H2 is cleanup. This is a localized, bounded change to the CSP middleware configuration for development workflows, not a systemic capability or critical path improvement.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to development/debug workflows and does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or critical path improvement. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains three hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H2 are complementary: P1.F1.H1 adds the bundle_origin and the devbox-specific resource_url, while P1.F2.H2 removes the now-redundant variable definitions. P1.F2.H1 adds a test. The chunk is complete and does not appear truncated. No indication of unrelated PRs. No missing context.

observations.behavior: Adds a computed bundle_origin from settings.JS_URL and uses it to construct resource_url for DEBUG/TEST mode, including the remote Vite host.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows CSP middleware to include the remote Vite host in the script-src directive when running in debug/test mode, supporting development workflows where JS is served from a remote host rather than localhost.

observations.behavior: Removes the now-redundant variable definitions for js_url and bundle_origin, as they are no longer needed after the P1.F1.H1 changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Cleanup of removed dependencies; no functional change, but P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H2 are complementary. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that the CSP policy includes both localhost and the remote Vite host when JS_URL is set to a remote domain.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression test for the devbox CSP behavior. No score assigned.
